newsitem.title: GERMANY: Pfleiderer to reorganise and raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Pfleiderer to reorganise and raise capital.

text.p: Germany's Pfleiderer group said on Tuesday it will merge its activities under a new shareholding company which it plans to list on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange.

The company said its listed subsidiary Pfleiderer Bau- und Verkehrsysteme AG, which makes construction and transport equipment, as well as Pfleiderer GmbH, a holding company, will be merged with Pfleiderer AG.

The merged company Pfleiderer AG then plans to raise its capital in the final quarter of 1997, the group said in a mandatory statement. The aim is to exploit the potential for synergy benefits and to improve access to the capital markets.
For each 50-mark share in Pfleiderer Bau, shareholders will receive 22 five-mark shares in Pfleiderer AG plus 1.15 marks (66 cents) in cash, the group said.
The merged group aims to generate sales of about two billion marks in the 1996/1997 business year to May 31 with a workforce of about 7,800 people.
Pfleiderer said it was one of the leading companies in its field in Europe.
Its products include construction components and insulation material for the furniture industry and Do-It-Yourself Stores as well as transport and power technology.
